subject.title: fix(android): restore the complete Wear companion experience

question: Should OpenClaw formally support the restored multi-page Wear companion, including phone-proxied agent selection and gateway connection controls, as part of the Android product surface?
rationale: The branch is not limited to a narrow rendering repair: it adds four protocol operations and a broad companion control surface whose long-term support and update behavior need owner intent.

options.title: Sponsor the full companion scope
options.body: Confirm agent and gateway controls as supported Wear capabilities, then require version-skew handling before merge.

options.title: Narrow to a regression restoration
options.body: Retain only the previously supported visible workflow and defer new control capabilities to a separately approved proposal.

options.title: Pause for Android/Wear design review
options.body: Keep the draft open while an area owner defines the supported companion contract and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full companion scope
recommendation.body: Confirm agent and gateway controls as supported Wear capabilities, then require version-skew handling before merge.

likelyOwner.person: Android/Wear area owner (not identified from available history)
likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the Android phone runtime, shared Wear protocol, and companion UI boundary.
